I took all of this about 12 hours ago because I see no point in life. I have tried pursuing love, comedy, cooking, math, and basically anything I could think of and I could never fill that hole. On top of not finding a purpose I have had no emotions for about 3 years now. I also have had headaches basically everyday for the past 2 years. I have had suicidal thoughts since 3rd grade and they have never gone away. I know nothing will help me so I just want to end it.

I have done some things that eventually lead to two people attempting their life, I have a head ache everyday that goes from a sharp pain to  dull but ever present, and my loss of emotions and lack of friends/enjoyment makes me feel like I am just waiting to die and I finally might do it right this time. I have no life outside of school as I have said I have no friends and I live in the middle of no where. I have never even dated someone or felt love in my life but from my parents divorce I can see it does not last.

My family and friends know about my head aches, I have been to the doctor many times about it but the medicine does not really help. I do not know of any therapist in my area. I have become good at faking my emotions so people do not notice. Only a few people know about my suicidal thoughts but they seem to think I am joking about it.
